summary: Full e2e testing of Grimoire MTG deck-builder. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (auth register/login/me, Scryfall proxy search/printings, deck CRUD, clone, public share, auth guards). Frontend: Complete e2e flow verified via Playwright - login, deck creation, Scryfall card search, add card, quantity cap at 4 (inc button disables), target switcher to Sideboard, autosave + manual save, printings dialog with alt arts, share dialog + public /d/:shareId page while logged out, dashboard clone, delete with confirm. All data-testids resolve. No blocking issues.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first mount when container has 0 size (initial empty deck). Harmless but spam console. Fix: wrap ResponsiveContainer with min dimensions or render only when cards.length > 0.
Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — a11y warning. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to each dialog.

action_items: (Minor/optional) Suppress Recharts 0-size warning by conditionally rendering ResponsiveContainer when cards exist or giving container explicit min height/width.
(Minor/a11y) Add DialogDescription to Dialog/Sheet contents (new-deck-dialog, share-dialog, printings dialog, analytics sheet).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ADMIN_PASSWORD seeding is idempotent (updates hash if changed) - good. bcrypt hashes verified ($2b$ format).
server.py: get_current_user accepts Bearer OR cookie - frontend uses Bearer per spec; fine.
No brute-force lockout implemented on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Not required by original spec but flagged.
map_card() uses c.get('colors') or c.get('color_identity') — for colorless cards 'colors' is [] (falsy) so it falls back to color_identity, which is acceptable.
DeckBuilder autosave skipSave flag prevents save on initial load — good UX pattern.
No max file size issues; files are reasonably small.
seed_data_creation: Only transient TEST_ decks created during tests; all cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_grimoire_api.py. Scryfall is a live external API — occasional flakes possible. Note that @*.test TLD is rejected by pydantic EmailStr; use @example.com for test emails. In the DeckBuilder, the search card Add button lives inside a hover overlay (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100), so Playwright must .hover() the parent before clicking add-card-<id>, OR use force=True.
